name: Spotted Shag
rangeDescription: Coastal north, south, and stewart islands (new zealand)
description: A slim, medium-sized, gray-blue marine shag with yellow-orange feet and a long, slender bill. Breeding plumage is elegant with bright green facial skin, blue eye-rings, and two curved thick white stripes that extend from each eye down to the side of the neck.

name: Crowned Cormorant
rangeDescription: Coastal southwestern africa (angola to south africa)
description: A small, plain-backed cormorant that is restricted to near-shore marine environments, where it is uncommon. Sometimes it occurs in coastal estuaries alongside the similar Long-tailed Cormorant, which has a shorter crest (year-round), a pale-speckled back, and a relatively longer tail.

name: Maui Parrotbill
rangeDescription: Maui (ohia montane forest on east slopes of haleakala crater)
description: A very rare Hawaiian honeycreeper of high elevation wet forests on eastern Maui. The thick, parrotlike bill used to tear and crush stems in search of insects and larvae is diagnostic.

name: White-eared Solitaire
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru and western bolivia (la paz and cochabamba)
description: Beautiful, boldly patterned bird of montane forest. Reddish brown above, black below, with a black head, broad white mustache, and coral red bill.

name: Violet-throated Metaltail
rangeDescription: Páramo of andes of south-central ecuador (azuay)
description: High-elevation hummingbird endemic to the Andes of southern Ecuador. Plumage is mostly green with a purple throat, and tail is blue on top and greenish underneath.

name: Plain-breasted Piculet
rangeDescription: Floodplain of the río ucayali and amazon river in eastern peru, southeastern colombia, and far western brazil
description: Relatively plain piculet found in dense riverine and secondary vegetation along the Amazon and its tributaries in Peru, barely making it into southernmost Colombia and westernmost Brazil. Plumage generally pale below with a brownish back.

name: Pale Mountain-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Bougainville to guadalcanal and malaita (solomon islands)
description: A long-tailed pigeon with striking plumage contrast. Dark gray on the back and wings with an entirely white underside and tail.

name: Beaudouin's Snake-Eagle
rangeDescription: Southwestern mauritania southward to guinea, eastward to southwestern sudan and western south sudan, possibly to northern uganda
description: Chunky dark brown raptor with a white belly marked by thin bars. Immatures are brown when perched, and show rufous patches in the underwing in flight.

name: Andean Slaty Thrush
rangeDescription: Breeds in the andes of southern bolivia (north to santa cruz) and northwestern argentina (southward to córdoba), also locally in southwestern ecuador and northwestern peru; nonbreeding migrant to the east slope of the andes from southeastern ecuador to bolivia
description: A distinctive gray thrush found in montane forests below around 2,000 m from Peru to Argentina. Males are medium-gray above and paler gray below with a darker head, lightly streaked throat, and a yellow bill and eyering.

name: White-crowned Parrot
rangeDescription: Caribbean slope of southeastern mexico to western panama
description: Medium-size, blue-green parrot of tropical lowlands, mainly in humid forest and forest edge. The big white crown patch and white throat on a bluish head are distinctive; also note the pinkish-red patch under the tail.

name: Halmahera Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (morotai, halmahera, bacan, and kasiruta)
description: A thrush-sized bird with a fairly long horn-colored bill. Uniform rich olive-green above and all yellow underneath, with dark eyes.

name: Neblina Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Central andes of peru (southern amazonas to huánuco)
description: Small tapaculo found only at very high elevations in the eastern Andes of Peru. Male is gray with black and brown barring on lower underparts and rump.

name: Chinese Pond-Heron
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southern asia; winters to greater sundas
description: Often mistaken for an egret in flight due to its all-white wings, but the dark head separates it from any egret. This medium-sized heron is found across many different marshy habitats.

name: White-tailed Emerald
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southern costa rica to central panama
description: Small hummingbird with restricted range in Costa Rica and western Panama. Male is mostly glittering emerald with a bright white lower belly and outer tail feathers.

name: Lesser Seedcracker
rangeDescription: Eastern tanzania to southern malawi, eastern zimbabwe, and northern mozambique
description: A colorful, chunky waxbill with a large conical bill. Both sexes have a red hood and tail, but females have slightly less extensive red.

name: Kosrae White-eye
rangeDescription: Kosrae (eastern caroline islands)
description: Small ash-gray warbler-like bird, endemic to the Micronesian island of Kosrae. Combination of uniform coloration, size, and pale eye-ring makes this species unique on the island.

name: Bahama Warbler
rangeDescription: Grand bahama, little abaco, and great abaco
description: This charming species is fond of pine woods where it is often found creeping along branches and trunks in a manner similar to that of the Black-and-white Warbler. Also visits flowers.

name: Blanford's Rosefinch
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of nepal to southeastern tibet and southwestern china
description: Attractive medium-sized finch of subalpine coniferous areas; may move down to upper foothills in the winter. Male is predominantly pinkish raspberry-red with a white vent and lower belly.

name: Peruvian Sheartail
rangeDescription: Arid western peru to far northern chile (arica)
description: Tiny hummingbird of desert lowlands and foothills; found in gardens, agricultural areas with flowers, and native scrub. Adult male with long black-and-white tail “streamers” is basically unmistakable, but greatly outnumbered by females and immatures, which look much like several other small hummingbirds.

name: Black Coucal
rangeDescription: Intra-african migrant south of the sahara
description: Small coucal of marshes, swamps, and wet grassland. Distinctive in breeding plumage: black with a rufous wing.
